## Plan

Recon findings that fix the design:

- **TLS home = new crate `crates/hh-tls`** (52nd member). A `hh-wire::tls`
  module would put rustls in the dependency root — every one of the 51
  members would transitively carry a TLS stack (and hh-wire's pure-std /
  foreign-port posture would bend). A dedicated member keeps the ADR's
  "one crate may name rustls" scope honest: only `hh-tls` names it;
  `hh-gateway`, `hh-env`, `hh-embed` consume the typed stream API
  (`hh-tls` itself stays workspace-dep-free; dev-dep `hh-wire` for the
  codec in tests).
- Version set (crates.io checked 2026-10-21, ≥7-day rule vs
  2026-10-14 cutoff): `rustls =0.23.46` (pub 2026-10-14, newest 0.23.x,
  not yanked; 0.24 is dev-only), `rustls-webpki =0.103.15` (2026-08-21;
  0.103.16 is 1 day old → excluded), `webpki-roots =1.0.9` (2026-07-18;
  1.0.10 is 2 days old → excluded), `rustls-pki-types 1.15.1`,
  `once_cell 1.21.4`, `zeroize 1.9.1`, `subtle 2.6.1`, `untrusted 0.9.0`
  + the already-admitted `ring =0.17.14`. Features: `default-features =
  false` + `["ring","std","tls12"]` — ring provider only, no `log`, no
  `aws-lc-rs`.
- `hh_wire::http`: `HttpUrl` gains `scheme: Scheme` (`http`|`https`,
  default ports 80/443); `connect` stays the TCP dial (TLS wraps after).
- `hh-gateway::HttpModelTransport` gains a `tls: ClientTls` (webpki
  roots by default; `with_tls` for extra-roots/mTLS); `https` endpoints
  take the TLS stream through the same codec — `tls_pending` retired
  (other schemes still refuse typed).
- `hh-embed` `decode_model_lane` admits `https://` + optional `tls{}`
  params (`extra_roots_file`, `client_cert_file` + `client_key_file`
  pair); `ModelLane.tls` persists on the manifest member; a TLS config
  error is a typed `InvalidDefinition` at arm, never a silent plain
  fallback. `GatewayModel::new` → `Result` (the one caller updated).
- `hh-env` egress: `EgressTransport` gains `forward_tls` (default typed
  refuse); `LocalTlsTransport` (LocalHttpTransport + `ClientTls`)
  answers `terminates_tls() = true`; the mediator dispatches TLS legs
  to `forward_tls` — `tls.terminate = true` honoured, else the existing
  `TlsTerminateUnsupported` refusal stands; `tls_terminated` member
  already truthful.
- Test PKI: `scripts/gen-test-pki.sh` (openssl, 3650d) →
  `crates/hh-tls/fixtures/pki/` (CA, server SAN IP:127.0.0.1/DNS:hh.test,
  wrong-SAN cert, client cert for mTLS, rogue-CA cert) — marked
  test-only; `.gitleaks.toml` allowlist row by path.
- Peer identity: `hh_tls::peer_identity` — subject CN walk + SAN
  dNSName/URI via rustls-webpki `EndEntityCert` over the verified peer
  chain (server side for R4.7a, client side for the wire row).
- Live leg `https-reachability`: cargo-test leg,
  `hh-tls:r4_5c_live:https_get_public_endpoint` — one GET
  `api.github.com/zen` (per contract) with full webpki verification;
  `HH_LIVE_SKIP:` marker → honest `skipped(<reason>)` (new small arm in
  `run_leg_cargo_test`).
- Bookkeeping: ADR-0365 (ADR-0359 pattern); `Cargo.toml`/AGENTS.md/
  crates/AGENTS.md hermetic notes amended; ADR-0266/0340/0341
  fired-answered notes; DF-S2.4-2 → DONE; COVERAGE_MATRIX R-2.8.3/4 →
  MET with dated re-verdict; adr-index regen; BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER rows.

## Gap table

| Gap found | Clause | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| `connect` tried only the first resolved address — dual-stack `localhost` died on the v6 refusal | Honest refusal / wire truth | `hh_wire::http::connect` walks the full resolved set (each addr gets the dial deadline) |
| `RevokeIntent` carried no `scheme` — a revocation for an `https` destination would dispatch a plain `http` leg (silently-plain) | CC3/honest refusal — the revoke rides the carrier the credential rode | `RevokeIntent.scheme` added; `dispatch_revocations` picks `HttpsConnect` for `https` |
| `live-verify` `script` leg needed a `set -e`-guarded cargo invocation — unguarded `{ }` aborts on rc≠0 before `rc` reads | ADR-0363 honesty | `run_leg_https_reachability` uses the `if … else rc=$?` shape (same as `run_leg_cargo_test`) |
| github `/zen` answers 415 on `Accept: text/plain` | live leg truth | `Accept: application/vnd.github+json` — 200 + body |
| Nonblocking-listener accepted sockets can be nonblocking (platform-dependent) — `tls.accept`'s `complete_io` needs blocking | fixture honesty | TLS fixture restores `set_nonblocking(false)` on accept |
| `ServerTlsStream`/`TlsStream` dropped without `close_notify` → peer `UnexpectedEof` on close-delimited reads | wire truth | `Drop` sends `close_notify` + flush on both streams |
| **Size budget: 900 changed lines** — measured ≈2,800 total (≈2,200 code+tests excl. fixtures/`Cargo.lock`/generated) | size budget clause | **Deviation recorded** — the ticket is atomic (one dep admission + its four consumers + the LT battery); the R4.5a/R4.5b precedent (recorded Deviation, orchestrator accept) is followed: surfaced in the PR + this ledger, not silently exceeded |
